description: Creation of the Virtual City in Kandy under the Virtual City Creation Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The city of Kandy, which houses the historic Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, has been identified to create in the name of Virtual City in Kandy as a pilot project of the Virtual City Creation Project. It has been planned to technically create 58 locations identified as priority sites with tourist attractions and tourist potential which are centered around the city of Kandy as the first part of the said pilot project and 20 locations of historical and tourism significance associated with the historical Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic and its surroundings as the second phase of the project. The Ministry of Digital Economy has recommended Sri Lanka Telecom PLC as the suitable entity for the relevant work after evaluating the feasibility and technical capabilities of the production company and the previous production work carried out by the said Company. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to carry out the production activities of the Virtual City in Kandy Project by Sri Lanka Telecom PLC using the provisions allocated under the Clean Sri Lanka Project, was approved by the Cabinet.
